EnableGuiltyGear.Name: Enable Guilty Gear/Strive automation
EnableGuiltyGear.Hint: Enables the gauge, Stun Edge/Dire Eclair/Faultless Defense, and Strive-tier (Sacred Edge/Ride the Lightning/Dragon Install) automation.

GuiltyGearMoveNames.Name: Guilty Gear move name(s)
GuiltyGearMoveNames.Hint: Move name(s) (comma-separated) recognized by the level-up "Learn" button and the unlock logic.

StriveMoveNames.Name: Strive move name(s)
StriveMoveNames.Hint: Move name(s) (comma-separated) recognized by the level-up "Learn" button and the unlock logic.

StriveRequiredLevel.Name: Strive required level
StriveRequiredLevel.Hint: Minimum character level for the Strive "Learn" button to appear in the level-up dialog.

GuiltyGearMeleeMoveNames.Name: Melee move name(s)
GuiltyGearMeleeMoveNames.Hint: Move name(s) (comma-separated) used for gauge gain (roll of 7+) and for triggering Dire Eclair/Ride the Lightning. Enter the actual basic melee move name(s) used in your campaign.

GuiltyGearDefendMoveNames.Name: Defend move name(s)
GuiltyGearDefendMoveNames.Hint: Move name(s) (comma-separated) that Faultless Defense reacts to.

GaugeGainMeleeThreshold.Name: Gauge gain roll threshold
GaugeGainMeleeThreshold.Hint: Gain 1 gauge when a melee move roll total is at or above this value.

DragonInstallHpPercent.Name: Dragon Install HP percent
DragonInstallHpPercent.Hint: Dragon Install auto-activates when HP is at or below this percent of max (rounded) and gauge is full.

GuiltyGear.DragonInstallActivated: HP dropped to 30% or below with a full gauge — Dragon Install activates!
GuiltyGear.DragonInstallDeactivated: HP rose back above 30% — Dragon Install deactivates.
GuiltyGear.GaugeBadgeTitle: Click to manually adjust the gauge.
GuiltyGear.PendingDamageBonusApplied: The next weapon damage roll will automatically get +1d8.
GuiltyGear.FaultlessDefensePrompt: Faultless Defense: how much gauge do you want to spend on this Defend roll? (0-{gauge}, added as a +bonus to the roll)
GuiltyGear.FaultlessDefenseApplied: Spent {spend} gauge on Faultless Defense for a +{spend} bonus on this roll.
GuiltyGear.AskModeBadgeTitle: Click to cycle Always Apply / Ask Every Time / Never Apply.
